text:
josh-ml: quick check — trying to get athena-7b into the serving pipeline. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/athena-7b/v1/weights.tar.gz. can infra/legal confirm gating items?

nick-infra: saw the upload, thanks. ran the quick validate script, it flagged a tokenizer mismatch + config seq_len diff. gist: `tokenizer.json` BOS id = 1 but our standard expects 0; config.json has max_seq_len: 4096 while runtime default is 2048.

maya: oof, thanks for catching. if BOS differs we might get off-by-one logits for some prompts. we should either remap or update tokenizer metadata. i can run token remap and repack weights today. estimate ~2h.

ana-legal: FYI — license on the model card is CC-BY-NC-4.0 with an attribution clause and an explicit "no commercial use" restriction. that means we cannot serve it on the hosted tier without an enterprise approval. we can enable it on Dedicated/Private with customer acknowledgement.

josh-ml: good note. product asked whether we can host in a sandbox for internal QA — is that allowed under NC?

ana-legal: internal dev/test is allowed under NC; commercial external access is not. however, the model card must include the required attribution string and we need to log the model's source and license in our model-registry entry before any deployment. also add the standard provenance field: "trained_on: dataset X (see license)".

nick-infra: deploy-bot ran a config lint and output: 
```
LINT: config.json: max_sequence_length mismatch (4096 vs runtime 2048)\nLINT: tokenizer.json: bos_token_id = 1 (expected 0)\nLINT: attribution: MISSING
```

deploy-bot: Automated scan: attribution missing on model card. Please add required line: "This model requires attribution to ExampleOrg and the original authors as described in the license."

maya: i'll do two things: (1) run tokenizer remap, create tokenizer.json with bos_token_id: 0 and include an alias mapping; (2) update config.json to set default max_sequence_length to 4096 and add a runtime-compat wrapper in our serving recipes so it doesn't break live defaults. will post the repacked s3 path when done.

josh-ml: thanks. on the gating checklist: can we enumerate final items so legal/infrastructure can sign off? my suggestion: [weights location, tokenizer validated with our tokenmap, config validated + serving wrapper, model card with license+attribution, registry entry with license and weights checksum, privacy check (PII sniff), final infra smoke test].

ana-legal: that's fine. add "clear statement of allowed usage" on the model card (NC), and an internal memorandum for sales/CS so they know not to offer hosted access. once the model card + registry entry are up, legal will sign off for private/dedicated usage only.

nick-infra: i'll run the smoke tests after maya posts repack. tests include: simple generation latency (1 prompt, 128 tokens), kv cache warmup, and a tokenization roundtrip test. will post results in thread.

maya: repack done, new weights: s3://redwood-models/athena-7b/v1/weights-repack-2026-03-17.tar.gz. tokenizer remapped, config updated. added metadata fields: "attribution": "Requires attribution to ExampleOrg et al.", "license": "CC-BY-NC-4.0", "source": "huggingface/athena-7b", "weights_sha256": "3b2f...ab9c".

deploy-bot: Scan complete: 
- tokenizer: OK (bos remapped)
- config: OK (runtime wrapper present)
- attribution: PRESENT
- license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (allowed: private/dedicated only)

nick-infra: smoke test results: latency 95th=120ms (local gpu), generation correct vs reference up to 128 tokens, tokenization roundtrip passed. no obvious regressions.

ana-legal: checked model card + registry entry. attribution line OK. license OK for private/dedicated. need one more item: include the following sentence in model card frontmatter: "Commercial use is prohibited under the model's license; contact legal@redwood.com for exceptions." after that's added, legal signs off.

josh-ml: added that sentence to model card at s3://redwood-models/athena-7b/v1/model-card.md and updated registry entry with weights_sha256 and license field.

maya: great — can we gate this to the "private" tenant and mark hosted=false in the serving metadata?

nick-infra: will do. setting serving.metadata.hosted = false and assigning model to private namespace. expecting deployment to Dedicated/Private only.

josh-ml: team, thanks for quick turnaround. will update the onboarding doc and the release notes. tagging @product for awareness. :thumbsup:

maya: leaving a short note for records: conversion script used: `./tools/token_remap.py --in tokenizer.orig.json --out tokenizer.json --bos 0` and repack command: `tar -czf weights-repack-2026-03-17.tar.gz weights/ tokenizer.json config.json model-card.md`

deploy-bot: Action completed: model flagged as PRIVATE in registry and audit entry created id=reg-20260317-009.

josh-ml: legal signoff?

ana-legal: signing off for private/dedicated only. documented in registry. :white_check_mark:

nick-infra: closing the loop — will monitor for any infra alerts during early traffic. reopen thread if anything pops.

maya: thanks all. ping me if you notice any weird tokenization edge cases during eval.

josh-ml: closing thread.
